items.title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
items.description: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. items.title: Participatory Moral AI Is Not Neutral: The Invisible Hand of Developers
items.description: As AI systems make more morally loaded decisions across society, one response has been moral preference elicitation. In this approach, researchers poll participants on hypothetical dilemmas and use the aggregated votes to train a policy that an AI model then applies at scale. items.title: RecipeNet: A Hierarchical Transformer for Recipe Data
items.description: Recipe data arises in domains such as materials synthesis, pharmaceutical formulation, and industrial manufacturing, where procedures are represented as ordered sequences of steps containing heterogeneous structured fields. items.title: Ensuring Safe Physical AI in Urban Mobility via Hazard-Informed Synthesized Envelopes
items.description: As heterogeneous robotic systems deploy across diverse urban zones, maintaining safety amid complex human-robot interactions remains a critical challenge. items.description: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) aims to automate neural network architecture design, reducing reliance on human expertise. items.description: Spreadsheets are widely used to organize, analyze, and manipulate semi-structured data, yet automated spreadsheet reasoning remains challenging for large language models (LLMs). items.title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports
items.description: In the current artificial intelligence-driven innovation era, the pace of knowledge growth is accelerating, and is hard to keep up with. While generative models are increasingly used to synthesize content, they often lack in information grounding. items.title: CytoBERT: A Foundation Model for Cytometry Data
items.description: Cytometry measures the complex characteristics of single cells (e.g., counts and protein expression of immune cells) and is widely used across immunological research and clinical settings.
